verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud ships AI-powered features such as Grafana Assistant and Investigations, so a training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or any AI data-use controls. Self-hosting or local storage options are user-side arrangements, not a documented capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
